title: Our village / Where are they going?
subtitle: 我们的村庄 / 他们要去哪儿？

lead.question: 你翻看村庄的照片，向朋友介绍「村庄在山谷里、河边上，孩子们正从校舍出来往公园走」——英语怎么把位置介词和「正在去/来」的进行时结合起来？
lead.warmup: 第 35 课是一段看图介绍：Our village is in a valley. It is between two hills. The village is on a river. 用 in/between/on 描述位置。然后用现在进行时讲人物动向：Some children are coming out of the building. Some of them are going into the park. 第 36 课把 Where are they going? 铺开十组。先试着用 between two hills / on a river 描述你的家或学校的位置。
goals: 能用 in a valley / between two hills / on a river 描述地理位置
能用现在进行时表示位置移动的动向（coming out of / going into）
能用 Where are they going? 询问去向
认识场景词：valley, hill, bank, water, swim, building, photograph, park, beside
lead.summary: 第 35 课介绍村庄与两张照片：村庄在山谷、两山之间、河边；作者与妻子沿河岸走；一个男孩在河里游泳；校舍在公园旁，孩子们正从楼里出来、部分走进公园。第 36 课把 Where are ___ going? 铺开十组（children/into the park, boy/across the river…），巩固「进行时表位移方向」。
lead.tips: ① 位置介词：in a valley（在山谷里），between two hills（在两山之间），on a river（在河边），beside a park（在公园旁）；② 进行时表动向：are coming out of（正从……出来），are going into（正走进）；③ another = an + other，另一（张照片）；④ along the bank 沿河岸；⑤ out of 从……里出来，into 进入。

questions.q: What are the children doing near the school building?
questions.zh: 孩子们在校舍附近在做什么？
questions.a: Some are coming out of the building; some are going into the park.
questions.aZh: 一些正从楼里出来，一些正走进公园。
questions.hint: 听 Some children are coming out of the building. Some of them are going into the park.

questions.a: In a valley, between two hills, on a river.
questions.aZh: 在山谷里，两山之间，河边。
questions.hint: Our village is in a valley. It is between two hills. The village is on a river.

questions.q: What is the boy doing in the water?
questions.a: He is swimming across the river.
questions.hint: There is a boy in the water. He is swimming across the river.

questions.q: Where is the school building in relation to the park?
questions.zh: 校舍相对于公园在哪里？
questions.a: Beside a park; the park is on the right.
questions.aZh: 在公园旁边；公园在右边。
questions.hint: This is the school building. It is beside a park. The park is on the right.

questions.q: Why does the text use 'are coming' / 'are going' (present continuous) for movement?
questions.zh: 为什么描述移动用 are coming / are going（进行时）？
questions.a: The present continuous of verbs of motion (come, go, leave) describes an action in progress — here, people moving from one place to another right now, not a fixed state.
questions.aZh: 位移动词（come/go/leave）的进行时描述正在进行的移动——此处人正从一处移向另一处，而非静止状态。
questions.hint: 进行时强调「正在移动中」。

questions.zh: ……要去哪儿？——……正去 ___。（把下面 10 组主语与方向挨个问一遍）
questions.a: Where are the children going? They are going into the park.
questions.aZh: 孩子们要去哪儿？他们正走进公园。
questions.hint: 进行时表位移；注意介词 into/out of/across/along。

grammar.title: 位置介词 in / between / on / beside
grammar.structure: in + 范围；between + 两者；on + 河边/表面；beside + 旁
grammar.definition: 描述地理位置：in a valley（在山谷里），between two hills（两山之间），on a river（在河边，临河），beside a park（在公园旁）。

examples.en: Our village is in a valley.
It is between two hills.

grammar.title: 现在进行时表位移方向
grammar.structure: be + coming / going / leaving + 方向介词短语
grammar.definition: come/go/leave 等位移动词的进行时表示「正在从一处移向另一处」，常配合 out of / into / across / along 等方向介词。

examples.en: Some children are coming out of the building.
examples.zh: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。

examples.en: Some of them are going into the park.
examples.zh: 他们中的一些正走进公园。

grammar.title: another 的用法
grammar.structure: another = an + other（又一个/另一个）
grammar.definition: another 后接单数可数名词，表示「又一个/另一（张、个）」，相当于 an other。Here is another photograph. 另一张照片。

examples.en: Here is another photograph of the village.
examples.zh: 这是村庄的另一张照片。

examples.en: I want another cup.

quiz.q: "Our village is in a valley." 中 in a valley 表示：
quiz.zh: in a valley 是什么意思？
quiz.note: in 表在范围里，in a valley 在山谷里。

quiz.q: "Some children are coming out of the building." 中 out of 表示：
"are going into the park" 的时态是：
quiz.note: are + going 是进行时，此处表正走进公园。

quiz.q: "on a river" 描述村庄位于：
quiz.zh: on a river 描述村庄？
